text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Ugh... For someone like me, was I just letting my guard down...?
choice_data_list: It's dangerous, so let's call it a day and rest.
Just be careful from now on, that's all.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
What's with the exaggeration?
Something like this is nothing to me.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...Even if I say that, you'll still worry, won't you?
Fine, I'll take a rest today just for you.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Just make sure you do it properly tomorrow to make up for it!
I'm definitely making back what we missed by resting!

After treating the injury, I decided to play it safe
and have her rest for the day.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I know.
I intend to do just that, too.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Geez... What am I even doing?
Wasting time resting like this is such a loss...!

After treating the injury, I decided to play it safe
and have her rest for the day.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Geez... And I didn't want to lose even
a single moment of training timeee...!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Hmph! Once we're done bandaging you up,
we're heading right back to training!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"There's no way I'm gonna let
something like this get me down!!"

After finishing the treatment, I decided to resume training
at Daiwa Scarlet's request.
